settings.heading: Polishing, forever
settings.text: Free, whenever a piece stops looking like itself. There is no time limit and no charge, including on pieces bought years ago.

settings.heading: Resizing, for life
settings.text: Free, up to three sizes either way. We send a prepaid insured label and it comes back in about ten days.

settings.heading: Repairs, quoted first
settings.text: Nothing is touched before you have the number. A snapped chain or a lost stone is usually a same-week job.

settings.heading: How do I send a piece in?
settings.text: Write to us with the piece number struck inside it. We reply with a prepaid insured label, and nothing is sent at your own risk.

settings.heading: What does a repair cost?
settings.text: Polishing and resizing are free. Anything else is quoted before work starts, and we will say when a repair is not worth the money.

settings.heading: Do you work on pieces you did not make?
settings.text: Yes, on the same terms: quoted first, and an honest answer about whether to do it at all.

settings.heading: Can an engraved piece be resized?
settings.text: One size, at most, before the engraving distorts. This is why engraved pieces are final sale, and we say it before you order.

settings.heading: Sending a piece back
settings.intro: The practical part. Anything not here, write to us and a person answers.

settings.heading: Ask about a repair
settings.intro: Tell us the piece number and what happened. We reply within two working days, with a quote before anything is touched.
